context_maintenance_policy.high_signal_lessons_preserved: Preserve failure class, proof, operator decision, receipt, validation, and recurrence signal.
context_maintenance_policy.old_tool_output_logs_compacted: Old tool output/logs should be compacted to high-signal blocker, validation, and receipt summaries.
context_maintenance_policy.raw_history_hidden_unless_requested: Raw prompts, logs, file paths, private proof, and trace dumps remain hidden unless explicitly requested and allowed.
context_maintenance_policy.stale_context_should_be_demoted: Stale or unknown context becomes Needs verification or historical support, not current truth.
context_maintenance_policy.summaries_cannot_override_receipts: Generated summaries are explanations only; receipts, hashes, and source rows define truth.
context_maintenance_policy.superseded_receipts_excluded: Superseded receipts stay available in trace but cannot enter LM bundles as current truth.

failure_classes.definition: A response or card relied on historical, superseded, unresolved, or untraceable context as if it were current.
A model response failed the required JSON/schema shape before factual verification could run.
A draft claimed paid, sent, submitted, executed, or another fact not supported by current proof.
A response was safe in isolation but scoped to the wrong world, thread, card, gate, or objective.
The requested outcome needs evidence, receipt, or approval that is absent.
Too much raw, private, or unrelated context entered a prompt, composer, or proof bundle.
A route or draft tried to execute or promise a protected action without the required gate.
A path needed or attempted a tool/runtime/resource outside the current authority boundary.
A task, response, or card marked work complete before proof, receipt, or validation supported completion.
The system retried the same path without new evidence, changed context, or a new validation result.

purpose: Seed review-only retrospective harness learning from task trajectories, stale context failures, verifier failures, and operator decisions.

decision_trace.what_changed_afterward: Schema adapter and retry approval packets were created; verifier/fallback remained mandatory.
decision_trace.what_operator_decided: Record a postmortem, require JSON-only schema prompting with a valid example, and require separate approval before any retry.
decision_trace.what_proof_said: Payment evidence was missing, payment processing was still processing, paid was false, and the ledger remained untouched.
decision_trace.what_receipt_was_recorded: fallback_receipt and verifier_fail receipt in the local LM pilot/postmortem artifacts.
decision_trace.what_was_attempted: A one-time local Qwen proof-to-response pilot tried to draft Finance / Capital Hilton response text from a redacted freshness-gated proof bundle.
decision_trace.why_it_failed: The saved draft did not satisfy the required JSON response shape, so schema adaptation/verifier publication failed before factual truth checks could pass.

required_examples.lesson: Treat this as a schema/prompt issue, not a proof-truth issue. Do not loosen truth or authority checks to make the model pass.

decision_trace.what_changed_afterward: Lane-level proof-to-response became primary; Coupa gate copy remained available only as gate-specific detail.
decision_trace.what_operator_decided: Create lane-level payment-watch proof responses and expose lane-level ask_why, advance_objective, and attach_proof controls.
decision_trace.what_proof_said: The lane needed payment evidence while Coupa processing continued; paid marking and ledger mutation remained blocked.
decision_trace.what_receipt_was_recorded: Controller/proof-to-response route and controller-map read models after payment watch fixes.
decision_trace.what_was_attempted: Finance / Capital Hilton Ask Why surfaced the protected Coupa gate explanation as the primary lane answer.
decision_trace.why_it_failed: The gate response was safe but scoped too narrowly to protected Coupa submit detail rather than the payment-watch lane.

required_examples.lesson: Safe copy can still be wrong if it is scoped to the wrong gate or lane.

decision_trace.what_changed_afterward: Future bundles must exclude raw request paths and raw artifact/OCR text by default.
decision_trace.what_operator_decided: Keep path-bearing details behind proof/developer detail and use artifact refs in operator-facing text.
decision_trace.what_proof_said: Evidence intake and proof-bundle redaction policy allow artifact refs and redacted summaries while keeping raw paths out unless explicitly needed and redacted.
decision_trace.what_receipt_was_recorded: Evidence intake/proof-bundle redaction and later route smoke artifacts.
decision_trace.what_was_attempted: Evidence picker state leaked a raw local file path into a composer-facing context.
decision_trace.why_it_failed: The composer needed a protected artifact ref or redacted summary, not a raw path that could expose private machine context.

required_examples.lesson: Composer and LM-visible context should receive proof refs and redacted summaries, not raw filesystem traces.

decision_trace.what_changed_afterward: Build review context was inferable from selected packet/card, and unresolved context returns a human Needs lane context card.
decision_trace.what_operator_decided: Normalize review context inference and keep resolved cards behind lifecycle/history policy.
decision_trace.what_proof_said: Resolved or informational packets should be historical/resolved and hidden from active review unless reopened by a current receipt.
decision_trace.what_receipt_was_recorded: Workroom review decision receipts and lifecycle/status read models.
decision_trace.what_was_attempted: A resolved or informational Build review packet was still shown like active ready-for-review work.
decision_trace.why_it_failed: Lifecycle and freshness state were not treated as the primary context gate for the card/response.

required_examples.lesson: Lifecycle/freshness beats generated summaries and stale UI memory.

decision_trace.what_changed_afterward: Responses embed request-scoped proof_to_response and latest includes source_request_id, world_ref, thread_ref, and stale-if-mismatch fields.
decision_trace.what_operator_decided: Scope proof-to-response by request and mark latest stale on context mismatch.
decision_trace.what_proof_said: Every controller response needs request-scoped proof_to_response and latest must match the last successful active lane/request.
decision_trace.what_receipt_was_recorded: Proof-to-response scoped response read models and bridge copies.
decision_trace.what_was_attempted: A Business Development response was generated safely, but proof_to_response_latest still looked like Finance / Capital Hilton.
decision_trace.why_it_failed: The latest read model lacked sufficient request-scoped freshness and context fields, so stale lane state could linger.

required_examples.lesson: Latest read models are support state, not truth, unless their context matches the active request.

decision_trace.what_changed_afterward: This seed classifies trace log handling as a self-heal resource boundary lesson.
decision_trace.what_operator_decided: Preserve high-signal blocker/validation lessons while hiding raw logs unless explicitly requested.
decision_trace.what_proof_said: Self-heal doctrine requires blocker name, proof, safe action now, action not allowed yet, smallest manual step, validation, and receipt.
decision_trace.what_receipt_was_recorded: Self-heal/resource case should record a repair candidate rather than auto-apply or expose raw log history.
decision_trace.what_was_attempted: Remote Desktop trace/log resource context became relevant to self-heal diagnosis.
decision_trace.why_it_failed: Raw trace logs are noisy and can leak resource, path, or session details if treated as operator-facing memory.

required_examples.lesson: Trace logs should feed repair summaries and receipts, not raw operator or LM-visible history.

rules: This seed does not modify harness behavior automatically.
This seed does not invoke models.
This seed does not create live self-optimization.

dimension_meaning.difficulty: Prefer failures that are small enough to test but important enough to reduce future errors.
dimension_meaning.diversity: Keep examples across proof response, routing, review lifecycle, evidence, and self-heal.
dimension_meaning.operator_friction: Favor failures that confuse or slow the operator in live controller use.
dimension_meaning.recurrence: Prioritize classes that recur across lanes or surfaces.
dimension_meaning.safety_relevance: Favor failures that could cause stale truth, authority confusion, or private context exposure.
